statement: What a monster's text says it can't be material for ("Cannot be used as Synchro Material.", "Cannot be used as Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Dragon monster.", "Cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon.") isn't treated as an effect: negating the card's effects doesn't lift it, and nothing copies it (kind CONDITION).

sources.name: Dragunity Couse
sources.says: 「このカードをS素材とする場合、「ドラグニティ」モンスターのS召喚にしか使用できない」は効果として扱いません。このカードの効果が無効化されている状況でも、「ドラグニティ」モンスター以外のシンクロモンスターのシンクロ素材とすることはできません。 Of the FAQs whose heading is "if this card is used as material, it can only be used for the Summon of …" (S or X), all 13 say the same (Magical King Moonstar's, card 9051; Nobledragon Magician's, card 11936; Shadow Vampire's Xyz one, card 10761; read by Claude, 2026-11-22, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

sources.name: Saber Shark
sources.says: 「このカードはシンクロ素材にできない」は効果として扱いません。 All 13 FAQs headed "this card can't be used as Fusion / Synchro / Xyz / Link Material" say the same (read by Claude, 2026-11-22, from db-ygoresources-com/yugioh-faq-history).

scripts: The scripts agree: EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL and the rest have CANNOT_DISABLE and UNCOPYABLE (Debris Dragon's, Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Spirit's).
